aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led browsers (mobile) in Turkey at 78.84% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 15.69%, followed by Samsung Internet at 2.82%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in Turkey?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 78.84% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/turkey.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in Turkey?
faqs.answer: Chrome (78.84%), Safari (15.69%), Samsung Internet (2.82%) in October 2026.
